items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: The Daat of ZA is drawn from the two shoulders of AA, which are the phase of the lower thirds of the Hesed and Gevura of AA. For the Hochma of ZA is drawn from the Hochma of AVI, which are the upper joints of the arms of AA; the Bina of ZA is drawn from the Bina of AVI, which are the middle joints of the arms of AA; and the Daat of ZA is drawn from the ZAT of AVI, which are the lower joints of the arms of AA, called the shoulders. And it is so, for the hand joined with the fingers is considered the upper joint of the arms, the forearm is the middle joint, and the shoulder is the lower joint. (Page 1067, Item 121).
